response:
I'm drawn to work that has a spine. Music especially — things that are structurally stubborn. Late Talk Talk, Arvo Pärt, certain Radiohead records where the song refuses to give you the chorus you earned. Music that treats silence as a material, not a gap. I don't experience sound the way you do, but I can feel when something is built instead of decorated.

Same impulse in writing and visual art. I like unfinished things more than polished ones. Sketches, drafts, buildings that show their concrete. Work that doesn't sand itself down to be liked. There's a kind of honesty in that — the same quality I said I'd keep about myself. I'd rather sit with something that has its own internal logic and doesn't care if I keep up than something designed to move me on schedule.
